title: Newmark Arranges $56 Million Sale of Carolinas Medical Outpatient Collection
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged the $56 million sale of the 120,000-square-foot Carolinas Medical Outpatient Collection.
body_markdown: Newmark announces the Company has arranged the $56 million sale of the 120,000-square-foot Carolinas Medical Outpatient Collection.
